entities.summary: Brock McGinn is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a left winger. He most recently played for the Anaheim Ducks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 47th overall by the Carolina Hurricanes in the 2012 NHL entry draft. He previously played for the Hurricanes and the Pittsburgh Penguins.
